_doc: Starting points, not decisions. Every value here is overridable per run (a flag, or a make variable of the same name). Pick per run from the facts: make check-jobs (queues), sweep-estimate (p90 memory per design), design-show (peak memory of one design), license-check (seats). Read through slurm/site_config.py default SECTION KEY. Site facts live in site.json.

sweep._doc: synthesis nodes of slurm/sweep.sh: --qos --time --mem --memfree --nodes; slots per node default to min(seats / nodes, slots_per_node_max)

sweep_driver._doc: the sweep.sh driver job itself (make DRIVER_QOS= DRIVER_TIME= DRIVER_MEM=); the #SBATCH header in sweep.sh is only the fallback for a bare sbatch

rerun_failed._doc: rerun_failed.py: --qos --time --memfree --parallelism; on shared, --mem defaults to mem_per_design x slots

catapult._doc: the launcher Perlmutter_scripts/catapult_shell.sh: CATAPULT_VER picks the install under catapult_root, CATAPULT_PRODUCT the license (ultra|genesis); both env vars override

job_array._doc: legacy job-array path (slurm/cli.py --slurm-*, used by iter_manager_catapult.py --slurm)
